description: Arbolado en amenaza de volcamiento o falla. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Jardín Botánico de Bogotá "José Celestino Mutis" - JBB. Individuos del arbolado urbano de Bogotá que presentan alta frecuencia de falla por volcamiento, resultado del análisis de las bases datos actuales del SIGAU incluyendo la información de árboles inactivos e integración de nuevos factores de amenaza de volcamiento o falla del arbolado urbano, como mecanismo para la gestión del riesgo en la ciudad de ... Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Jardín Botánico de Bogotá "José Celestino Mutis" - JBB. Its tags are Amenaza, Arbolado Urbano, Riesgo, Volcamiento. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KML. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
